mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 2% over the prior 8 weeks reduces the present value of future equity cash flows, thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 2% and remains above for 8 consecutive weeks
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not statistically lower than during the 8-week pre-trend period (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by monthly PAYEMS exceeds 100,000 jobs and coincides with stronger consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In samples where PAYEMS > 100000 and CPIAUCSL > 250, 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO < 108) followed by a rebound above 108 indicates a turning point in supply-side constraints, prompting a positive S&P 500 5-day forward return.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO crosses below 108 then crosses above 108 within the same month
failure_condition: No significant positive 5-day forward return occurs after such a bottom signal in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly RSAFS falls by more than 10% from its prior month's level, it reflects excess demand absorption, which reduces growth expectations and produces negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In regimes where RSAFS declines >10%, 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) below 255 for three consecutive months suggests deflationary pressure, which typically precedes a positive S&P 500 60-day forward return.
failure_condition: Over 60-day window following the 3-month deflation signal, SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than the prior 60-day average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 3.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates weakening labor market resistance, which often coincides with equity risk-on sentiment and positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In such UNRATE regimes, 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising HOUST (household spending) above 1,200 suggests accelerating consumer demand, which is associated with positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: No significant positive 5-day forward return occurs when HOUST rises above 1200 for two months in at least 70% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low industrial production (INDPRO < 105) and high unemployment (PAYEMS < 90,000) simultaneously signals a supply-side recession, predicting negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In regimes matching the trigger, 60-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05).
